NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Alma Computer Use controls other applications on your behalf when the AI agent needs to interact with desktop apps. This permission is used only while an automation command is running.
NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Alma Computer Use captures individual application windows so the AI agent can see what it is interacting with. The rest of your screen is not captured.
NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Alma Computer Use may request apps to raise a window via Apple Events when the Accessibility action is unavailable.
